title: Harden release publishing workflow

context.summary: Make GitHub release publishing complete for public self-host users.
context.background: Release automation must publish signed artifacts, Docker images and release notes from a tag.

in: Publish versioned release bundles, signed manifests and checksums.
Build and publish Docker images with documented tag policy.
Generate draft release notes and public release checklist.
Add workflow validation without storing secrets in the repository.
Remove TASK-108-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.
out: Cutting an actual production release tag unless explicitly requested.

acceptance_criteria: Tag workflow builds Docker images and release artifacts.
Signed manifests and checksums are attached to draft GitHub releases.
Release notes include support matrix and upgrade notes.
Workflow documents required repository secrets without committing values.

manual_checks: Confirm workflow can run in pull request validation without publishing.

risks: Release publishing must not push images from untrusted pull requests.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
